name: Chatbot UI
description: Open-source ChatGPT-like interface for interacting with OpenAI models through a clean, self-hosted web app.

env.label: OpenAI API Key
env.description: API key from OpenAI for accessing GPT models

env.label: OpenAI API Host
env.description: Custom OpenAI API endpoint URL for compatible providers

env.label: OpenAI API Type
env.description: API type to use (openai or azure for Azure OpenAI Service)

env.label: OpenAI Organization
env.description: OpenAI organization ID if you belong to multiple organizations

env.label: Default Model
env.description: Default OpenAI model to use for conversations (e.g. gpt-4, gpt-3.5-turbo)
